rows.question: Which user roles must be supported in v1?
rows.answer: Designer, Approver, Viewer, Admin (email/password sign-in with role selection). Maps to BR-09.

rows.question: What screens constitute the UI + mock API MVP?
rows.answer: Login, Dashboard (portfolio + status filters + 3-step new-store wizard), Layout Editor (M1/M2/M4), Products & Categories (M3), Analytics (M5), Admin & Config (M6 tabs: Users & Roles, Store Master, Approval Workflow, Configuration, Audit Log).

rows.question: What layout editor capabilities are in scope for MVP?
rows.answer: Scaled canvas (rectangular + irregular/polygon), fixture palette with custom measurements, aisle min-width/accessibility validation, auto-calc fixture count on dimension change, category-to-shelf mapping with color coding, interactive 2D and 3D (Three.js) views.

rows.question: How are verticals supported without code changes?
rows.answer: Global + vertical-specific configuration for UoM, fixture/category templates, compliance rules. Target verticals: General Retail, Pharmacy/Pharma, Beauty & Cosmetics, Apparel & Footwear. Top-bar vertical selector.

rows.question: What analytics are required for MVP?
rows.answer: Space utilization, category allocation, shelf capacity, and layout version comparison (BR-08). Mock data acceptable in UI + mock API phase.

rows.question: What are the core domain entities?
rows.answer: User, Role, Store, Layout (versioned), Zone, Aisle, Fixture, Category, Product, CategoryMapping, VerticalConfig, AuditEvent, ApprovalWorkflow.

rows.question: What persistence model for UI + mock API phase?
rows.answer: Assume: Express mock API with in-memory / JSON seed store for prototype; MongoDB schema designed for Day-1 platform-fit but may be stubbed until SEED-00. Documented as assumption A-D2.

rows.question: Are store dimensions provided at creation?
rows.answer: Yes — length/width/height or floor-plan polygon boundaries available at layout creation (project.md §7).

rows.question: External system integrations in MVP?
rows.answer: None. Out of scope: POS, real-time inventory, procurement, structural engineering, foot-traffic sensors.

rows.question: Auth mechanism for UI + mock API phase?
rows.answer: Mock email/password + role selection; session/token issued by API. No external IdP in this phase. Assumption A-I2.

rows.question: Canonical API contract location?
rows.answer: Docs/openapi.yaml — edit before changing API shapes.

rows.question: 3D performance constraints?
rows.answer: Must perform on standard business hardware; no specialized GPU. Three.js for interactive 3D.

rows.question: Platform / stack constraints?
rows.answer: ADR-0001 MERN + Python modular platform as-is (no ADR-0017 exception for MVP). React web, Express API, Mongo (or mock), Python for auto-calc/analytics capability services as needed.

rows.question: Multi-tenancy Day-1?
rows.answer: Single-tenant prototype org for UI+mock API; design APIs with tenantId optional header for future isolation (ADR-0006). Assumption A-N3.

rows.question: Branding constraints?
rows.answer: ShelfPilot brand: primary #A30A2A, gradient #C4183A→#A30A2A, neutrals #F0F0F0/#1f2933, Plus Jakarta Sans + DM Mono, Built by the Foundry attribution.

rows.question: What is in scope for this delivery?
rows.answer: Store setup & canvas, fixtures, aisle validation, category/product management, 2D/3D rendering, auto-calculation, analytics & reporting, administration, system configuration — UI + mock API phase.

rows.question: What is explicitly out of scope?
rows.answer: POS integration, real-time inventory/stock, physical fixture procurement, architectural/structural engineering, foot-traffic sensor hardware.

rows.question: Missing source docs referenced by project.md?
rows.answer: BRD/FRD still deferred. UI visual SoT now present: ui/ShelfPilot.dc.html + ui/brand.md. React app must match this reference.

rows.decision: Mock API persistence: in-memory vs Mongo for prototype
rows.options: In-memory+JSON seed (faster MVP) | Mongo from Day-1

rows.decision: Auto-calc location: Node service vs Python capability service
rows.options: Node in Express for MVP | Python microservice from SEED-05
